name: youtube-roast
description: Roast de canales de YouTube basado en evidencias públicas, sin inventar historial privado.

scripts.dev: npm run build && concurrently -k -n web,api "vite --host 127.0.0.1" "wrangler dev --local --port 8787"
scripts.check: npm run test && npm run build
scripts.deploy: npm run check && wrangler deploy --env production
scripts.deploy:dry: npm run check && wrangler deploy --env production --dry-run
